current_official_findings.verified: Persistent Composite DTM 1m WCS GetCapabilities endpoint is explicitly published; WCS 2.0.1 serves raw elevation pixels and GeoTIFF NoData handling remains part of the client contract. The endpoint could not be parsed here because application/xml was rejected and the alternate download attempt returned no bytes.
GET /products lists OpenData products and can return expanded product details in JSON; product discovery must precede hard-coded download assumptions.
GET /products/{productId} returns current product metadata; a 404 means unknown product/content and is not evidence that terrain data are absent at a target.
Terrain50 uses per-tile GEMINI XML metadata and identifies 10km National Grid tile reference; metadata remains part of the provenance gate before secondary elevation promotion.
10km tiles contain 200x200 50m pixels; heights are calculated at pixel centres, edge values are not shared between adjacent tiles, and coastal modelling may introduce small tile-edge steps.
